blocks.content: The Authority shall consist of a Chairperson and not more than six members, to be appointed by the Central Government, out of whom at least three shall be Whole-Time Members.

items: Frequently tested in exams: The maximum age limit for the Chairperson is 65 years, whereas for Members it is 62 years.
Note the minimum requirement: At least 3 Whole-Time Members are mandatory in the composition.
All members, including the Chairperson, are appointed directly by the Central Government.

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: The Pension Fund Regulatory and Development Authority (PFRDA) consists of a Chairperson and not more than six members appointed by the Central Government.
Out of the maximum six members, at least three must be Whole-Time Members.
The Chairperson holds office for a term of 5 years or until attaining the age of 65 years, whichever is earlier, and is eligible for re-appointment.
Whole-Time and Part-Time members hold office for a term of 5 years or until reaching the age of 62 years, whichever is earlier.
The Central Government reserves the authority to remove any member from office under specific conditions specified in the PFRDA Act.
